snippet.title: Run a cozy occult shop and use witchcraft to help people. -  The Totemist
snippet.description:
Step into the strange little world of The Totemist, a dark-cozy occult shop sim where you craft totems and talismans, help the townsfolk carry their burdens, and uncover the darkness hiding beneath it all.

Demo is out now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4545470/The_Totemist/ 

Wishlist on Steam to be notified of the full release!
